content.short: EarnTV (ETV) is a blockchain-based video content delivery protocol for content owners, advertisers, and end-users.
content.description: EarnTV is a blockchain-based, multi-platform video content delivery protocol designed to serve content owners, advertisers, and end users. By leveraging a system of smart contracts, it simplifies aggregation, marketing, and distribution, opens new monetization pathways, and helps ensure audiences are rewarded fairly. The project draws on more than 50 years of combined experience in television and cinema from veteran media professionals, who bring deep industry insight to a decentralized approach to video.
